name: Dry stitched composite preform

original_specification.name: Dry stitched composite preform
original_specification.description: Uncured-looking reinforcement and stitching form an exposed textile structure.
original_specification.optical_model: Region- and ply-aware composite appearance with separate reinforcement, resin and surface-process structure.
original_specification.scale_policy: Store scene lengths in mm and angles in radians. Preserve physical feature size across part resizing. Use thread geometry where stitches are resolved.
original_specification.authoring_method: Original deterministic procedural recipe with versioned seed; optional in-house reference capture for later calibration. No third-party asset is included.
validation: No resin layer should appear unless explicitly added.
Check on a flat coupon, a curved part and an exposed edge under fixed neutral illumination; this is a proposed check, not a completed validation.

limitations: Illustrative authored RGB material; no measured optical/engineering certification.
Bump/height is not automatically geometric displacement.
Full original specification retained; generated realization is not every required physical capability.
preview_contract: Original approximate authoring swatch, not a SolidCraft render or optical validation.
normal_convention: normal_gl: +Y tangent-space, V image-up; normal_dx flips green. glTF UV0 V image-down, tangent basis supplied.
ao_contract: ORM red is constant 1; no fictitious cavity occlusion baked in.

native_contract.uniform_look: supported; textures/advanced optics are not encoded in an appearance-library entry
native_contract.runtime_texture_request: opaque planar fields only; explicit file capture and exact target required
native_contract.persistent_new_texture_binding: not installed in the application built-in catalog; requires future importer
native_contract.full_optical_intent: portable material and recipe; native support is capability dependent
